The Cursed One#003.src: For all that the festival revolves around the crown, I've always appreciated its representation of our culture.
The Cursed One#003.dst: Même si le festival tourne autour de la Couronne, j'ai toujours aimé la façon dont il représente notre culture.
The Cursed One#003.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#004.src: Good job friend! You showed those mudkins!
The Cursed One#004.dst: Bien joué, l'ami! Tu leur as montré, à ces Mudkins!

The Cursed One#005.src: As of late, I have felt a distinct lack of impact in our actions. Certainly- we've done good for the downtrodden and overlooked! But we have failed to make any real change.
The Cursed One#005.dst: Ces derniers temps, nos actions me semblent manquer d'impact. Certes- nous avons fait le bien pour les opprimés et les oubliés! Mais nous n'avons rien changé de réel.
The Cursed One#005.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#006.src: Yeah, curses, blessings - whatever. So, what, you think all of us could just... use "magic"? What would that even look like?
The Cursed One#006.dst: Ouais, malédictions, bénédictions - peu importe. Alors quoi, on pourrait tous juste... utiliser la "magie"? Ça ressemblerait à quoi?
The Cursed One#006.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#007.src: However, the traditional "cursed one" mythos has the afflicted wielding such power without the use of any blessed artifacts.
The Cursed One#007.dst: Cependant, dans le mythe traditionnel du "Maudit", l'affligé manie ce pouvoir sans le moindre artefact béni.
The Cursed One#007.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#008.src: As an example- I learned that I have an affinity for the fire element, but I didn't know what form that would take until I actually received my blessing.
The Cursed One#008.dst: Par exemple- j'ai appris que j'avais une affinité avec le Feu, mais je ne savais pas quelle forme elle prendrait avant de recevoir ma bénédiction.
The Cursed One#008.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#009.src: Return to the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#009.dst: Retournez au camp de la résistance, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#010.src: {u}, it's good to see you. Have you been well?
The Cursed One#010.dst: {u}, ça me fait plaisir de te voir. Tu vas bien?
The Cursed One#010.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#011.src: ...no one has recognized you in {p}, have they?
The Cursed One#011.dst: ...personne ne t'a reconnu à {p}, n'est-ce pas?
The Cursed One#011.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#012.src: Good, good. Be sure to tell me if it does happen, and we'll figure out what to do from there.
The Cursed One#012.dst: Bien, bien. Préviens-moi si ça arrive, et on verra quoi faire à ce moment-là.
The Cursed One#012.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#013.src: Anyway, since you're here, I'd like to follow up on our earlier discussion. About... magic.
The Cursed One#013.dst: Bref, puisque tu es là, j'aimerais reprendre notre discussion de tout à l'heure. Sur... la magie.
The Cursed One#013.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#014.src: I would like for you to describe what you know of it, how you use it, and how most people in your province can wield it.
The Cursed One#014.dst: J'aimerais que tu me décrives ce que tu en sais, comment tu l'utilises, et comment la plupart des gens de ta province la manient.
The Cursed One#014.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#015.src: I've informed the Leaves about our plans, and those interested will join us. Though, I will not force anyone to attend if they do not wish to. Are you ready?
The Cursed One#015.dst: J'ai informé les Feuilles de nos plans, et ceux que ça intéresse viendront. Mais je n'obligerai personne à venir s'il ne le souhaite pas. Tu es prêt?
The Cursed One#015.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#016.dst: Bien, tout le monde! C'est l'heure de la réunion!
The Cursed One#016.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#017.src: Teach the Leaves in the Wind magic.
The Cursed One#017.dst: Enseignez la magie aux Feuilles au vent.

The Cursed One#018.src: Hello, everyone. Hm... has anyone seen Sui?
The Cursed One#018.dst: Bonjour, tout le monde. Hm... quelqu'un a vu Sui?
The Cursed One#018.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#019.src: She told me she did not feel particularly comfortable listening in on this discussion, so I did not push her further.
The Cursed One#019.dst: Elle m'a dit qu'elle n'était pas très à l'aise à l'idée d'écouter cette discussion, alors je n'ai pas insisté.
The Cursed One#019.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#020.src: I see. I think it would be good for her to hear this, though. Could someone fetch her for me?
The Cursed One#020.dst: Je vois. Je pense pourtant qu'il serait bon qu'elle entende ça. Quelqu'un pourrait aller la chercher?
The Cursed One#020.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#021.src: I can go find her, ma'am.
The Cursed One#021.dst: Je peux aller la chercher, madame.
The Cursed One#021.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#024.src: It... isn't something you need to worry about. Not yet, at least.
The Cursed One#024.dst: Ce... n'est pas à toi de t'en inquiéter. Pas encore, du moins.
The Cursed One#024.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#025.src: Magic... or, rather, curses have a tendency to be associated with bad memories.
The Cursed One#025.dst: La magie... ou plutôt, les malédictions sont souvent liées à de mauvais souvenirs.
The Cursed One#025.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#026.src: It's not my place to tell you why. Sui can share more if she wants to, later.
The Cursed One#026.dst: Ce n'est pas à moi de te le dire. Sui t'en parlera plus tard, si elle le veut.
The Cursed One#026.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#028.src: I have my reasons for it. I believe it would be better for her to hear this now, rather than later.
The Cursed One#028.dst: J'ai mes raisons. Je pense qu'il vaut mieux qu'elle entende ça maintenant plutôt que plus tard.
The Cursed One#028.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#029.src: Here we are! So, could we get started already? Some of us actually have responsibilities.
The Cursed One#029.dst: Nous voilà! Alors, on peut commencer? Certains d'entre nous ont des responsabilités, figurez-vous.
The Cursed One#029.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#030.src: Seeing as everyone is here, yes, Rex, we may. {u}, let us start with the basics.
The Cursed One#030.dst: Puisque tout le monde est là, oui, Rex, nous pouvons. {u}, commençons par les bases.
The Cursed One#030.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#031.dst: La magie est... en toute chose.

The Cursed One#032.src: Ah, yes, such as the cursed... the stories do tell of the original evil lurking within us. It would follow that it exists in all things.
The Cursed One#032.dst: Ah, oui, comme les maudits... les récits parlent bien du mal originel tapi en nous. Il s'ensuivrait qu'il existe en toute chose.
The Cursed One#032.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#033.src: Indeed. So {u}, how do you wield your magic?
The Cursed One#033.dst: En effet. Alors, {u}, comment manies-tu ta magie?
The Cursed One#033.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#034.src: Similar to the blessed implements of the crown's commanders, yes? I remember hearing of this from the military recruiters.
The Cursed One#034.dst: Comme les instruments bénis des commandants de la Couronne, n'est-ce pas? J'en ai entendu parler par les recruteurs de l'armée.
The Cursed One#034.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#035.src: Don't those usually only have one specific blessing attached to them? I don't remember them being as... uh, flexible, I guess.
The Cursed One#035.dst: Ceux-là n'ont pas d'habitude une seule bénédiction précise? Je me souviens pas qu'ils soient aussi... euh, souples, je suppose.
The Cursed One#035.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#036.src: You'd be correct, Rex, though the same principle applies. A blessed weapon is referred to as a "focus" by the crown. They allow the wielder to more easily access the blessing placed within.
The Cursed One#036.dst: Tu as raison, Rex, mais le principe est le même. La Couronne appelle "focalisateur" une arme bénie. Il permet à son porteur d'accéder plus facilement à la bénédiction qu'il renferme.
The Cursed One#036.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#037.src: Ah, I do have experience with this. We call it mana. Once one receives a blessing, it takes time to learn how to draw from your own source of mana.
The Cursed One#037.dst: Ah, ça, je connais. Nous appelons ça le mana. Une fois qu'on reçoit une bénédiction, il faut du temps pour apprendre à puiser dans sa propre source de mana.
The Cursed One#037.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#038.src: This is where foci come into play - they are crafted or forged from mana-dense materials, and so provide a more easily accessible source to power one's blessing.
The Cursed One#038.dst: C'est là qu'interviennent les focalisateurs - fabriqués ou forgés dans des matériaux riches en mana, ils offrent une source plus accessible pour alimenter sa bénédiction.
The Cursed One#038.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#039.src: Most people in Wynn could us
The Cursed One#039.dst: La plupart des gens de Wynn pourraient u

The Cursed One#040.src: And, so... what? You think any of us could just... do it? That's hard to believe.
The Cursed One#040.dst: Et donc... quoi? N'importe qui parmi nous pourrait juste... le faire? Dur à croire.
The Cursed One#040.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#041.src: If given the right tools and

The Cursed One#042.src: Ha! If it were truly the case, would there not be many, many more cursed ones running around? I concur with Rex, it seems outlandish.
The Cursed One#042.dst: Ha! Si c'était vraiment le cas, n'y aurait-il pas bien plus de Maudits en liberté? Je suis d'accord avec Rex, cela paraît extravagant.
The Cursed One#042.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#043.src: I d- d- don't know... {u} doesn't seem like they're l- ly- like they're lying. What- wh- what if it is true?
The Cursed One#043.dst: J- j- je sais pas... {u} n'a pas l'air de m- me- de mentir. Et- et- et si c'était vrai?
The Cursed One#043.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#044.src: It would explain certain aspects of the crown's response to cursed ones...
The Cursed One#044.dst: Ça expliquerait certains aspects de la réaction de la Couronne envers les Maudits...
The Cursed One#044.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#045.src: But... if you didn't receive a blessing, doesn't it still make you cursed?
The Cursed One#045.dst: Mais... sans bénédiction, ça ne fait pas quand même de toi un maudit?
The Cursed One#045.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#046.src: Yes, precisely! My sister is correct. Any... "magic" not sourced from the crown is innately tainted, from my understanding.
The Cursed One#046.dst: Oui, précisément! Ma soeur a raison. Toute... "magie" qui ne vient pas de la Couronne est intrinsèquement souillée, à ce que je comprends.
The Cursed One#046.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#047.src: Ha. Right, sure. "Belief." So if I think hard enough, I can just start calling down lightning strikes?
The Cursed One#047.dst: Ha. Ouais, c'est ça. "Croire." Donc si je me concentre assez fort, je peux me mettre à faire tomber la foudre?
The Cursed One#047.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#048.src: Ugh. This was a waste of time.
The Cursed One#048.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#049.src: Now, now, Rex. Don't be so hasty in writing it off entirely. You have seen with your own eyes what {u} can do!
The Cursed One#049.dst: Allons, allons, Rex. Ne balaie pas tout si vite. Tu as vu de tes propres yeux ce que {u} sait faire!
The Cursed One#049.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#050.src: Belief... I- I- I can do that.
The Cursed One#050.dst: Croire... J- j- je peux faire ça.
The Cursed One#050.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#051.src: Oh, come on Zeph, really? You can't seriously-
The Cursed One#051.dst: Oh, allez, Zeph, sérieux? Tu peux pas sérieusement-
The Cursed One#051.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#052.src: We're getting off track. {u}, what else is there?
The Cursed One#052.dst: On s'écarte du sujet. {u}, quoi d'autre?
The Cursed One#052.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#053.src: So... s- so you don't even know what your m- ma- magic will look like?
The Cursed One#053.dst: Donc... d- donc tu sais même pas à quoi ressemblera ta m- ma- magie?
The Cursed One#053.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#054.src: Correct. There are aptitude tests which the crown uses before giving out blessings, but those only provide an idea of the general typing.
The Cursed One#054.dst: Exact. La Couronne fait passer des tests d'aptitude avant d'accorder des bénédictions, mais ils ne donnent qu'une idée du type général.
The Cursed One#054.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#055.src: Oh! S- s- so, what type of magic do you think I w- would- I would have?
The Cursed One#055.dst: Oh! A- a- alors, quel type de magie tu crois que j'a- aur- que j'aurais?
The Cursed One#055.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#056.src: Something with wind, probably. You have that sort of... feel to you. Hey- we'll be the Leaves, and you can be the Wind!
The Cursed One#056.dst: Un truc avec le vent, sûrement. T'as ce genre de... allure. Hé- on sera les Feuilles, et toi tu pourras être le Vent!
The Cursed One#056.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#057.src: He- hey! That... oh, that would be c- c- cool, actually...
The Cursed One#057.dst: Hé- hé! Ça... oh, ça serait g- g- génial, en fait...
The Cursed One#057.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#058.src: If I may interrupt- thus far, you have spoken at length on casting through the use of a focus.
The Cursed One#058.dst: Si je puis me permettre- jusqu'ici, tu as longuement parlé de lancer des sorts à l'aide d'un focalisateur.
The Cursed One#058.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#059.src: There are people like that i
The Cursed One#059.dst: Il existe des gens comme ça e

The Cursed One#060.src: Aha. Of course, then those must be the dangerous ones.
The Cursed One#060.dst: Ah. Bien sûr, ce doivent donc être eux, les dangereux.
The Cursed One#060.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#062.src: Uncommon, but still common enough to maintain the reputation the cursed have... It would make sense.
The Cursed One#062.dst: Rares, mais assez nombreux pour entretenir la réputation des maudits... Ça tiendrait debout.
The Cursed One#062.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#063.src: Well, thank you for your time, {u}. I think we'll call it there. You're all dismissed.
The Cursed One#063.dst: Bien, merci pour ton temps, {u}. Je crois qu'on va s'arrêter là. Vous pouvez disposer.
The Cursed One#063.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#064.src: ...So what, is- is that it? We talk about th- th- theory for a while, and th- a- and then do nothing?
The Cursed One#064.dst: ...Et quoi, c- c'est tout? On parle de th- th- théorie un moment, et pu- e- et puis on fait rien?
The Cursed One#064.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#065.src: Zeph, even if {u}'s information is true, it doesn't mean it's immediately applicable.
The Cursed One#065.dst: Zeph, même si ce que dit {u} est vrai, ça ne veut pas dire qu'on peut l'appliquer tout de suite.
The Cursed One#065.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#066.src: If I could be certain that experimenting with cur-... magic... would be safe, maybe there could be an opportunity here. As it stands... it's too risky.
The Cursed One#066.dst: Si j'étais certaine qu'expérimenter avec les malé-... la magie... était sans danger, il y aurait peut-être une occasion à saisir. En l'état... c'est trop risqué.
The Cursed One#066.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#067.src: R- ris- risky... maybe the reason we've been stuck is because we d- d- we don't take risks!
The Cursed One#067.dst: R- ris- risqué... si on est coincés, c'est peut-être parce qu'on p- p- on prend jamais de risques!
The Cursed One#067.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#068.src: The per- perfect opportunity to be a- a- able to hold our own against the c- cr- crown, a- and- and we're gonna do n- no- nothing? Are you h- hear- hearing yourself?
The Cursed One#068.dst: L'oc- l'occasion parfaite de p- p- pouvoir tenir tête à la C- Co- Couronne, e- et- et on va rien f- fai- faire? Tu t'e- ent- t'entends parler?
The Cursed One#068.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#070.src: No, I- I'm gonna ta- take the chance. Even- e- even if no- nobody else will. Come- c- come on, {u}, let's go.
The Cursed One#070.dst: Non, m- moi je vais t- tenter ma chance. Même- m- même si pe- personne d'autre le fait. Viens- v- viens, {u}, on y va.
The Cursed One#070.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#072.src: Sigh. I suppose I should have expected something like this. Of all the children, he's the one with the most to prove...
The Cursed One#072.dst: Soupir. J'aurais dû m'attendre à quelque chose comme ça. De tous les enfants, c'est lui qui a le plus à prouver...
The Cursed One#072.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#073.src: You may as well go with him, {u}. Maybe you'll be able to prove my worries wrong.
The Cursed One#073.dst: Autant que tu l'accompagnes, {u}. Tu me prouveras peut-être que j'avais tort de m'inquiéter.
The Cursed One#073.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#074.src: Hum... I suppose the pieces fit together, yet...
The Cursed One#074.dst: Hum... Les pièces s'emboîtent, je suppose, et pourtant...
The Cursed One#074.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#075.src: I... I may have gotten a bit h- he- heated there...
The Cursed One#075.dst: Je... je me suis peut-être un peu e- em- emporté...
The Cursed One#075.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#076.src: It's just... all so- s- so frustrating! So often, people are h- hur- hurt by the crown, and- and th- there's nothing we can do about it! If we had m- m- if we had m- magic, we'd be able to- to sta- stand up to them!
The Cursed One#076.dst: C'est juste... tellement- t- tellement frustrant! Si souvent, des gens se font b- bl- blesser par la Couronne, et- et on p- peut rien y faire! Si on avait la m- m- si on avait la m- magie, on pourrait- pourrait leur t- te- tenir tête!
The Cursed One#076.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#077.src: But, they don't... eugh. What- wh- whatever. We can just-
The Cursed One#077.dst: Mais ils font pas... beurk. P- p- peu importe. On peut juste-
The Cursed One#077.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#080.src: Well, I can't just let you go off and do this on your own. Even if I think it's stupid and reckless.
The Cursed One#080.dst: Bah, je peux pas te laisser faire ça tout seul. Même si je trouve ça stupide et irréfléchi.
The Cursed One#080.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#081.src: So, what's the plan? You didn't just run off without one, right?
The Cursed One#081.dst: Alors, c'est quoi le plan? T'es pas parti en courant sans plan, hein?
The Cursed One#081.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#084.src: Hey! I know that I- I need a f- fo- focus, right? We just need to find some... s- some magical materials to ma- make it out of. Even if I- I- I don't know where to... look.
The Cursed One#084.dst: Hé! Je sais que j'- j'ai besoin d'un f- fo- focalisateur, non? Il faut juste trouver des... d- des matériaux magiques pour le f- fabriquer. Même si j- j- je sais pas où... chercher.
The Cursed One#084.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#085.src: Sigh. Okay. Well, luckily for you, I know a spot. Remember that cave to the west of the festival grounds? Soldiers were swarming the place a week or two ago. Blocked it off 'cause of... cursed activity, or something.
The Cursed One#085.dst: Soupir. Bon. Heureusement pour toi, je connais un coin. Tu te souviens de la grotte à l'ouest du site du festival? Il y a une semaine ou deux, ça grouillait de soldats. Ils l'ont bloquée pour cause d'... activité maudite, un truc comme ça.
The Cursed One#085.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#086.src: And... y- you- you think there might be s- some- something there?
The Cursed One#086.dst: Et... t- tu- tu crois qu'il pourrait y avoir q- quel- quelque chose là-bas?
The Cursed One#086.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#087.src: Yep! Why else would they prevent people from going there for so long? There's gotta be something.
The Cursed One#087.dst: Ouaip! Sinon, pourquoi ils en interdiraient l'accès aussi longtemps? Il doit forcément y avoir un truc.
The Cursed One#087.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#088.src: Okay. It's w- worth a shot... Thanks for the help, Rex.
The Cursed One#088.dst: D'accord. Ça v- vaut le coup d'essayer... Merci pour ton aide, Rex.
The Cursed One#088.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#089.src: Don't mention it. We'll just have to follow those blue flowers, they'll lead us right to the cave. I'll stand guard outside while you two search it.
The Cursed One#089.dst: De rien. On n'a qu'à suivre ces fleurs bleues, elles nous mèneront droit à la grotte. Je monterai la garde dehors pendant que vous la fouillez.
The Cursed One#089.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#091.src: Head to the blocked off cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#091.dst: Rendez-vous à la grotte condamnée, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#092.src: ...Hm? What? I'm not here for you, just to be clear.
The Cursed One#092.dst: ...Hm? Quoi? Je suis pas là pour toi, que ce soit clair.
The Cursed One#092.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#093.src: You should stop wasting time talking to me, and hurry up after Zeph already.
The Cursed One#093.dst: Arrête de perdre ton temps à me parler, et file rattraper Zeph.
The Cursed One#093.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#094.src: He's probably trying to compete with you to see who can get to the end fastest, and every second you spend here is not doing you any favors in beating him.
The Cursed One#094.dst: Il essaie sûrement de faire la course avec toi pour voir qui arrive au bout le premier, et chaque seconde passée ici ne t'aide pas à le battre.
The Cursed One#094.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#095.src: Heh. Not that you'd win anyway!
The Cursed One#095.dst: Hé. Pas que tu risques de gagner, de toute façon!
The Cursed One#095.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#096.src: Hah! Too s- sl- slow! I guess I probably sh- should- should've warned you about the r- roly-bugs...
The Cursed One#096.dst: Ha! Trop l- le- lent! J'aurais sûrement d- dû- dû te prévenir pour les r- roly-bestioles...
The Cursed One#096.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#097.src: If you're quiet en- enough, they usually don't bother you. I th- th- I think you even woke up the lea- leader of the colony!
The Cursed One#097.dst: Si t'es assez di- discret, d'habitude elles t'embêtent pas. J- j- je crois que t'as même réveillé le ch- chef de la colonie!
The Cursed One#097.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#098.src: Anyway... I think Rex was right. Lo- look at these crystals! If- if a- any- anything's magical, it's got to be them!
The Cursed One#098.dst: Bref... je crois que Rex avait raison. Re- regarde ces cristaux! Si- si q- quel- quelque chose est magique, c'est forcément eux!
The Cursed One#098.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#099.src: Let's grab some and g- get- get out of here. We don't want to get c- cau- caught in a res- restricted area.
The Cursed One#099.dst: Prenons-en quelques-uns et s- sor- sortons d'ici. Faudrait pas se faire p- pin- pincer dans une zone in- interdite.
The Cursed One#099.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#100.src: I'll take one... M- may- maybe we should take some more? In ca- c- in case anyone else wants to- y- you know. Co- coming back here again later would be da- dangerous.
The Cursed One#100.dst: J'en prends un... P- peu- peut-être qu'on devrait en prendre plus? Au ca- c- au cas où d'autres voudraient- t- tu vois. Re- revenir ici plus tard serait da- dangereux.
The Cursed One#100.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#101.src: Grab a crystal before you leave.
The Cursed One#101.dst: Prenez un cristal avant de partir.

The Cursed One#102.src: Took you long enough! So, who won the race?
The Cursed One#102.dst: C'est pas trop tôt! Alors, qui a gagné la course?
The Cursed One#102.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#103.src: You say that like you don't a- al- already know, Rex!
The Cursed One#103.dst: Tu dis ça comme si tu le s- sa- savais pas déjà, Rex!
The Cursed One#103.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#104.src: I didn't know we were racing
The Cursed One#104.dst: Je ne savais pas qu'on faisait la course

The Cursed One#105.src: Excuses, excuses. You should always have your guard up around Zeph. You never know when he'll strike with a surprise race.
The Cursed One#105.dst: Des excuses, toujours des excuses. Avec Zeph, faut toujours rester sur ses gardes. On sait jamais quand il va te sortir une course surprise.
The Cursed One#105.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#106.dst: Je suis si- si prévisible que ça?
The Cursed One#106.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#109.src: Sure, Zeph. Well, what'd you find? I haven't seen anybody out here, so I think we're in the clear to go if we're done here.
The Cursed One#109.dst: C'est ça, Zeph. Bon, vous avez trouvé quoi? J'ai vu personne dans le coin, donc on peut y aller tranquilles si vous avez fini.
The Cursed One#109.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#110.src: We fou- found some crystals growing at the end of the cave. They f- fe- feel magical to me, so... they should w- wor- work. Let's get going back.
The Cursed One#110.dst: On a trou- trouvé des cristaux qui poussaient au fond de la grotte. Ils ont l'air m- ma- magiques, alors... ils devraient m- mar- marcher. Rentrons.
The Cursed One#110.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#111.src: Come on. Just because we're in the clear now doesn't mean we can dilly-dally. Let's go.
The Cursed One#111.dst: Allez. C'est pas parce qu'on est tranquilles qu'on peut traîner. On y va.
The Cursed One#111.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#112.src: Let's get going back. I r- really hope these crystals w- wor- work.
The Cursed One#112.dst: Rentrons. J'e- j'espère vraiment que ces cristaux v- von- vont marcher.
The Cursed One#112.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#113.src: ...Ah! You return! I'd best inform miss Syndra of your arrival.
The Cursed One#113.dst: ...Ah! Vous revoilà! Je vais prévenir madame Syndra de votre arrivée.
The Cursed One#113.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#114.src: You were wai- waiting for us? Why?
The Cursed One#114.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#115.src: Hrm... I suppose your words resonated with me, in the end. Having taken some time to mull it over while you were gone... I must admit, you make a solid point.
The Cursed One#115.dst: Hum... Je suppose que tes paroles ont fini par me toucher. J'y ai réfléchi pendant votre absence... et je dois admettre que ton argument tient la route.
The Cursed One#115.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#116.src: Well, you're not the only one feeling that way, if it makes you feel any better. I think Syndra's the same.
The Cursed One#116.dst: Bah, t'es pas le seul à penser ça, si ça peut te rassurer. Je crois que Syndra pense pareil.
The Cursed One#116.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#117.src: Even more reason to try something new, then! This... magic, as you call it- if indeed it is what you have described, though I still have my doubts-
The Cursed One#117.dst: Raison de plus pour essayer quelque chose de nouveau, alors! Cette... magie, comme tu l'appelles- si elle est bien ce que tu as décrit, même si j'ai encore des doutes-
The Cursed One#117.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#119.src: Yes, Rex, I appreciate the encouragement- as I was saying, it could be just what we need to truly make a difference.
The Cursed One#119.dst: Oui, Rex, merci pour tes encouragements- je disais donc que ce pourrait être ce qu'il nous faut pour vraiment changer les choses.
The Cursed One#119.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#120.src: ...I h- ho- hope so. Um... you said you were g- go- going to tell Syndra we were back?
The Cursed One#120.dst: ...J'e- j'es- j'espère. Euh... tu disais que tu a- al- allais prévenir Syndra qu'on était rentrés?
The Cursed One#120.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#121.src: So I was! Allow me one moment, please.
The Cursed One#121.dst: En effet! Accordez-moi un instant, je vous prie.
The Cursed One#121.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#122.src: ...You're really sure you want to go through with this, Zeph?
The Cursed One#122.dst: ...T'es vraiment sûr de vouloir aller jusqu'au bout, Zeph?
The Cursed One#122.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#123.src: I- I am. I w- wa- I want to try it! Maybe then, I could...
The Cursed One#123.dst: O- oui. Je v- veu- je veux essayer! Peut-être qu'alors, je pourrais...
The Cursed One#123.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#124.src: Okay! Okay. It's your choice. I just worry sometimes!
The Cursed One#124.dst: D'accord! D'accord. C'est ton choix. Je m'inquiète, c'est tout!
The Cursed One#124.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#125.src: I... I ne- need to get into the r- r- right mood for it, I thi- I- I think. I'm... kind of ner- nervous, actually.
The Cursed One#125.dst: Je... il faut que je me mette dans le b- b- bon état d'esprit, je cro- j- je crois. Je suis... un peu ner- nerveux, en fait.
The Cursed One#125.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#126.src: ...Hey, {u}, could you... do- d- do some magic. As a- a d- dem- demonstration!
The Cursed One#126.dst: ...Hé, {u}, tu pourrais... fai- f- faire un peu de magie. En d- dé- démonstration!
The Cursed One#126.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#128.src: Rex is right, I'm not sure t
The Cursed One#128.dst: Rex a raison, je ne suis pas sûr q

The Cursed One#129.src: N- no, she- she's just paranoid. It'll be f- f- fine! You were casting sp- spells in the cave a- and- and nothing bad happened!
The Cursed One#129.dst: N- non, elle- elle est juste paranoïaque. Ça va b- b- bien se passer! Tu lançais des s- sorts dans la grotte e- et- et il s'est rien passé de mal!
The Cursed One#129.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#130.src: Sigh. If you insist, Zeph. Whatever you do had better be cool though, {u}.
The Cursed One#130.dst: Soupir. Si tu insistes, Zeph. Mais t'as intérêt à ce que ce soit stylé, {u}.
The Cursed One#130.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#132.src: Hm, I don't quite like the sound of "probably."
The Cursed One#132.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#133.src: Good- g- good enough for me! Come on, {u}, sh- show- show me a spell!
The Cursed One#133.dst: Ça- ç- ça me suffit! Allez, {u}, m- mon- montre-moi un sort!
The Cursed One#133.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#134.src: Showcase magic by casting spells in the resistance camp.
The Cursed One#134.dst: Faites une démonstration de magie en lançant des sorts dans le camp de la résistance.

The Cursed One#135.src: Woah! That w- was cool! Can you d- do- do it again?
The Cursed One#135.dst: Ouah! C'é- c'était génial! Tu peux r- re- recommencer?
The Cursed One#135.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#137.src: What's going on out here? I heard-
The Cursed One#137.dst: Qu'est-ce qui se passe ici? J'ai entendu-
The Cursed One#137.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#138.src: {u} is show- sh- showing me some magic!
The Cursed One#138.dst: {u} me mon- m- montre de la magie!
The Cursed One#138.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#139.src: ... I take it you found what you were looking for then?
The Cursed One#139.dst: ... Je suppose que vous avez trouvé ce que vous cherchiez, alors?
The Cursed One#139.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#140.src: Yup. Cursed crystals from the roly-nest.
The Cursed One#140.dst: Ouaip. Des cristaux maudits du nid de roly.
The Cursed One#140.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#141.src: The... of all places, you went to the roly-nest?! Did you even consider the risk?!
The Cursed One#141.dst: Le... de tous les endroits, le nid de roly?! Vous avez seulement pensé au risque?!
The Cursed One#141.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#142.src: What if you were caught? We are only able to operate here because we avoid drawing attention to ourselves. If you had been seen-
The Cursed One#142.dst: Et si on vous avait attrapés? Nous ne pouvons agir ici que parce que nous évitons d'attirer l'attention. Si on vous avait vus-
The Cursed One#142.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#143.src: But we weren't. I know the shift schedule of the guards, nobody was going to stop by while we were there.
The Cursed One#143.dst: Mais on nous a pas vus. Je connais les tours de garde, personne n'allait passer pendant qu'on y était.
The Cursed One#143.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#144.src: ...sigh. You children, you'll be the death of me. Fine. You found the crystals, and you weren't spotted - good.
The Cursed One#144.dst: ...soupir. Vous, les enfants, vous allez me tuer. Bon. Vous avez trouvé les cristaux, et personne ne vous a vus - très bien.
The Cursed One#144.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#145.src: Um... not to interrupt, or, anything, but... I missed the c- magic. Could you... show us some more?
The Cursed One#145.dst: Euh... sans vouloir interrompre, ou quoi, mais... j'ai raté la malé- la magie. Tu pourrais... en refaire un peu?
The Cursed One#145.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#147.src: Indeed. Thank you for the demonstration, {u}. Now, we should-
The Cursed One#147.dst: En effet. Merci pour la démonstration, {u}. Maintenant, nous devrions-
The Cursed One#147.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#148.src: Oh! Syndra, do- d- do you think you could show us something t- t- too? You're b- bl- blessed, so maybe it'd be-
The Cursed One#148.dst: Oh! Syndra, tu- t- tu pourrais nous montrer quelque chose a- a- aussi? T'es b- bé- bénie, alors peut-être que ce serait-
The Cursed One#148.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#150.src: ... O- o- okay! If- if you s- say- say so...
The Cursed One#150.dst: ... D- d- d'accord! Si- si tu le d- dis- dis...
The Cursed One#150.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#151.src: If we're done with the demonstrations, we should discuss-
The Cursed One#151.dst: Si on en a fini avec les démonstrations, on devrait parler de-
The Cursed One#151.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#152.src: But- b- but I want to tr- try now! I have a- a fo- focus, so I sh- should- I should be able to do... something.
The Cursed One#152.dst: Mais- m- mais je veux es- essayer maintenant! J'ai un- un fo- focalisateur, donc je d- dev- je devrais arriver à... un truc.
The Cursed One#152.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#153.src: Sigh. Yes, alright, Zeph. But let me guide you through it, would you?
The Cursed One#153.dst: Soupir. Oui, d'accord, Zeph. Mais laisse-moi te guider, tu veux bien?
The Cursed One#153.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#154.dst: Regardez Zeph tenter de faire de la magie.

The Cursed One#155.src: Take your position, Zeph. Everyone else, let's move out of the way.
The Cursed One#155.dst: En position, Zeph. Les autres, écartons-nous.
The Cursed One#155.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#156.src: Yes, indeed, it would not do well for us to be injured, unintentionally or otherwise. Come on, Sui!
The Cursed One#156.dst: Oui, en effet, il ne faudrait pas que nous soyons blessés, involontairement ou non. Viens, Sui!
The Cursed One#156.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#157.src: And we're sure this is safe?
The Cursed One#157.dst: Et on est sûrs que c'est sans danger?
The Cursed One#157.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#158.src: We have all seen {u} in action, and they appear to be unharmed, no?
The Cursed One#158.dst: Nous avons tous vu {u} à l'oeuvre, sans la moindre égratignure, non?
The Cursed One#158.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#159.src: Okay, sure, but what if someone sees? It's not like we're especially hidden here.
The Cursed One#159.dst: D'accord, ouais, mais si quelqu'un nous voit? C'est pas comme si on était super cachés ici.
The Cursed One#159.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#160.src: You know as well as I that the only ones showing up in these parts are outcasts and drunks!
The Cursed One#160.dst: Tu sais aussi bien que moi que les seuls à traîner dans le coin sont des parias et des ivrognes!
The Cursed One#160.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#161.src: In any case, we can make it quick. Zeph, are you ready?
The Cursed One#161.dst: Quoi qu'il en soit, on peut faire vite. Zeph, tu es prêt?
The Cursed One#161.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#162.dst: Oui! J- j- je suis prêt.
The Cursed One#162.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#163.src: Close your eyes, and hold the crystal close to your chest. Concentrate on the points of contact. Your hands, your chest. Do you feel anything?
The Cursed One#163.dst: Ferme les yeux, et serre le cristal contre ta poitrine. Concentre-toi sur les points de contact. Tes mains, ta poitrine. Tu sens quelque chose?
The Cursed One#163.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#164.src: ...oh! I- I do! It's l- l- like... st- static electricity, li- little sparks bouncing around...
The Cursed One#164.dst: ...oh! J- je sens! C'est c- c- comme... de l'é- électricité statique, des é- étincelles qui rebondissent...
The Cursed One#164.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#165.src: Good. Now, you'll try to draw your focus inwards. Imagine the sparks being pulled towards the center of your body. Feel them gathering together.
The Cursed One#165.dst: Bien. Maintenant, essaie de ramener ton attention vers l'intérieur. Imagine les étincelles attirées vers le centre de ton corps. Sens-les se rassembler.
The Cursed One#165.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#167.src: Now, finally, try releasing that energy. Concentrate on the crystal again, the points of contact. Imagine pushing the sparks back into it, and then further, sending them out through the crystal
The Cursed One#167.dst: Enfin, essaie de libérer cette énergie. Concentre-toi de nouveau sur le cristal, sur les points de contact. Imagine que tu repousses les étincelles dedans, puis plus loin, à travers le cristal
The Cursed One#167.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#169.src: Hey! Are you okay? Not hurt? I don't see anything visible, but-
The Cursed One#169.dst: Hé! Ça va? Pas blessé? Je ne vois rien de visible, mais-
The Cursed One#169.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#170.src: W- would you s- st- stop, already? I'm fine!
The Cursed One#170.dst: T- tu vas a- ar- arrêter, oui? Je vais bien!
The Cursed One#170.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#171.src: Ow! What- wh- what was that for?!
The Cursed One#171.dst: Aïe! Pou- p- pourquoi tu fais ça?!
The Cursed One#171.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#173.src: Well done, Zeph. You've done just as well as any of the soldiers I've seen receive blessings. Just... as well...
The Cursed One#173.dst: Bien joué, Zeph. Tu t'en es sorti aussi bien que tous les soldats que j'ai vus recevoir une bénédiction. Aussi... bien...
The Cursed One#173.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#174.src: ...was it really that easy all this time?
The Cursed One#174.dst: ...c'était vraiment aussi simple, depuis tout ce temps?
The Cursed One#174.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#176.src: Yes... yes, I'm alright. {u}, I apologize for doubting you. It would seem... you were right all along.
The Cursed One#176.dst: Oui... oui, ça va. {u}, pardonne-moi d'avoir douté de toi. Il semblerait... que tu avais raison depuis le début.
The Cursed One#176.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#177.dst: Ou alors Zeph est juste maudit...
The Cursed One#177.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#179.src: Sorry! Sorry. No, you're right. It was... cool, I guess. It's just... weird.
The Cursed One#179.dst: Pardon! Pardon. Non, tu as raison. C'était... cool, j'imagine. C'est juste... bizarre.
The Cursed One#179.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#180.src: A- a little, I guess. But it f- f- felt right. Like- l- like I always co- could have done it. Even if it was just sp- spark- sparkles.
The Cursed One#180.dst: Un- un peu, j'imagine. Mais ça m'a s- s- semblé juste. Comme- c- comme si j'avais toujours p- pu le faire. Même si c'était juste des é- étin- étincelles.
The Cursed One#180.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#181.src: That's part of the process. You'll need a proper focus to do more... specially-forged weapons have always done the trick, in my experience.
The Cursed One#181.dst: Ça fait partie du processus. Il te faudra un vrai focalisateur pour aller plus loin... d'expérience, les armes forgées sur mesure ont toujours fait l'affaire.
The Cursed One#181.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#182.src: Specially-forged weapons, you say? Miss, is there anything in particular one would need to create one? With the right materials, I'm certain I could forge Zeph what he needs.
The Cursed One#182.dst: Des armes forgées sur mesure, dites-vous? Madame Syndra, faut-il quelque chose de particulier pour en créer une? Avec les bons matériaux, je pourrais sûrement forger à Zeph ce qu'il lui faut.
The Cursed One#182.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#183.src: A- a new weapon? That I ca- can cast ma- magic with?
The Cursed One#183.dst: U- une nouvelle arme? Pour lancer de la ma- magie?
The Cursed One#183.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#184.src: I could see it coming in use. We'll want more sturdy materials than usual- preferably something that is magical in and of itself... Zeph, do you think you could-
The Cursed One#184.dst: Ça pourrait servir. Il nous faudra des matériaux plus solides que d'habitude- de préférence quelque chose de magique en soi... Zeph, tu crois que tu pourrais-
The Cursed One#184.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#185.src: Yes!!! I- I mean, uh, y- yes, I can do that.
The Cursed One#185.dst: Oui!!! Je- je veux dire, euh, o- oui, je peux faire ça.
The Cursed One#185.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#186.src: ...Okay! {u}, I kn- I- I know where to start! Me- meet me by the big tree to the n- nor- northeast! The one for the riddle!
The Cursed One#186.dst: ...D'accord! {u}, je s- je- je sais par où commencer! Re- retrouve-moi près du grand arbre au n- nor- nord-est! Celui de l'énigme!
The Cursed One#186.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#187.src: Head to the big tree and find Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#187.dst: Allez au grand arbre et trouvez Zeph en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#188.src: I suppose I should get around to firing up the forge... Sui, will you need me for anything?
The Cursed One#188.dst: Je suppose que je devrais aller allumer la forge... Sui, tu auras besoin de moi?
The Cursed One#188.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#189.src: Um... n-no, I don't think so.
The Cursed One#189.dst: Euh... n-non, je ne crois pas.
The Cursed One#189.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#190.src: He's taken to it remarkably well, hasn't he? Better than I could have hoped.
The Cursed One#190.dst: Il s'y est remarquablement bien fait, n'est-ce pas? Mieux que je ne l'espérais.
The Cursed One#190.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#191.src: {u}... you have opened a path for me that I never could have imagined. Thank you.
The Cursed One#191.dst: {u}... tu m'as ouvert une voie que je n'aurais jamais pu imaginer. Merci.
The Cursed One#191.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#195.src: Never in my life did I expect to have my whole world view challenged, hoh!
The Cursed One#195.dst: Jamais de ma vie je n'aurais cru voir toute ma vision du monde remise en question, ho!
The Cursed One#195.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#196.src: Admittedly, this information will take some time to progress...
The Cursed One#196.dst: Je l'avoue, il me faudra du temps pour digérer tout ça...
The Cursed One#196.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#197.src: I'll most likely seek you out later with some follow up questions.
The Cursed One#197.dst: Je viendrai sûrement te trouver plus tard avec d'autres questions.
The Cursed One#197.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#198.src: ...well, Synny, don't suppose any of this changes your usual approach?
The Cursed One#198.dst: ...alors, Synny, j'suppose que tout ça change rien à ta façon de faire?
The Cursed One#198.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#199.src: Sigh... You know it does, Kaio. If there's a possibility more of our members could wield magic, then...
The Cursed One#199.dst: Soupir... Tu sais bien que si, Kaio. S'il est possible que d'autres des nôtres manient la magie, alors...
The Cursed One#199.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#201.src: ... I don't know. I don't know if it'll work, yet.
The Cursed One#201.dst: ... Je ne sais pas. Je ne sais pas encore si ça marchera.
The Cursed One#201.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#204.src: Yes, well, I especially don't like this. Don't like the ideas you're gettin' all up there in your head. It's a risk.
The Cursed One#204.dst: Ouais, ben, ça, ça me plaît encore moins. J'aime pas les idées qui te trottent dans la tête. C'est un risque.
The Cursed One#204.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#205.src: Everything is a risk. But it doesn't matter yet. It'll depend on what Quill has to tell me during the festival.
The Cursed One#205.dst: Tout est un risque. Mais peu importe pour l'instant. Ça dépendra de ce que Quill aura à me dire pendant le festival.
The Cursed One#205.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#207.src: When I m- ma- when I make my weapon... do you think I'll be a- a- able to cast real spells? And not just... poofs of sp- s- sparkles?
The Cursed One#207.dst: Quand je f- fa- quand je ferai mon arme... tu crois que je p- p- pourrai lancer de vrais sorts? Et pas juste... des pouf d'é- é- étincelles?
The Cursed One#207.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#208.src: Having a weapon helps me cas
The Cursed One#208.dst: Avoir une arme m'aide à lan

The Cursed One#210.src: Sigh... I was h- h- hoping that- th- that I could do... I- I don't know! Something! A- any- anything to help. But... you're right.
The Cursed One#210.dst: Soupir... J'e- e- espérais que- que- que je pourrais faire... je- je sais pas! Quelque chose! N'im- n'importe quoi pour aider. Mais... tu as raison.
The Cursed One#210.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#211.src: Oh. O- okay! That means it- it m- might help me, too. Thank you.
The Cursed One#211.dst: Oh. D- d'accord! Alors ça- ça p- pourrait m'aider aussi. Merci.
The Cursed One#211.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#212.src: So, what are we doing here?

The Cursed One#213.src: Oh! R- ri- right! Well, Syndra said we sh- should find something magical, right? Well, I- I don't know for- f- for sure if it's magical or not, but...
The Cursed One#213.dst: Oh! C- c'e- c'est vrai! Syndra a dit qu'on d- devait trouver quelque chose de magique, non? Bon, je- je sais pas a- a- avec certitude si c'est magique ou pas, mais...
The Cursed One#213.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#214.src: A long, long time ago, th- this- this tree was more than just a stump! It had long arms st- str- stretching out over the whole forest, watching over th- the people and w- wi- wildlife.
The Cursed One#214.dst: Il y a très, très longtemps, c- cet- cet arbre était bien plus qu'une souche! Ses longs bras s'é- s'é- s'étendaient sur toute la forêt, veillant sur l- les gens et les a- ani- animaux.
The Cursed One#214.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#215.src: When anyone was hurt, o- or- or unwell, the tree would reach out with its br- branches and grow fruit- fruit that was said to he- h- heal all injuries and illnesses.
The Cursed One#215.dst: Quand quelqu'un était blessé, o- ou- ou malade, l'arbre tendait ses br- branches et donnait un fruit- un fruit qui, disait-on, gu- g- guérissait toutes les blessures et maladies.
The Cursed One#215.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#216.src: It took care of the people, and the p- people took care of the tree. But then- then the c- cur- curse took hold of the people.
The Cursed One#216.dst: Il prenait soin des gens, et les g- gens prenaient soin de l'arbre. Mais en- ensuite la m- mal- malédiction s'est emparée des gens.
The Cursed One#216.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#217.src: In the chaos and d- des- destruction caused by the cursed ones, the tree was hurt. It stopped gr- grow- growing its gifts, and went to sleep... f- forever.
The Cursed One#217.dst: Dans le chaos et la d- des- destruction causés par les Maudits, l'arbre a été blessé. Il a cessé de do- don- donner ses présents et s'est endormi... p- pour toujours.
The Cursed One#217.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#218.src: Even after the Queen arrived a- and blessed the people, the tree di- didn't- didn't wake up. Its trust had been broken...
The Cursed One#218.dst: Même après l'arrivée de la Reine, q- qui a béni les gens, l'arbre ne s'est p- pas- pas réveillé. Sa confiance avait été brisée...
The Cursed One#218.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#219.src: Ev- even though it's just a story... I hope s- some- someday the tree can trust us again. We could- c- could- we could really use its help, these days...
The Cursed One#219.dst: Mê- même si c'est juste une histoire... j'espère qu'un j- jour- un jour l'arbre nous refera confiance. On aurait- a- aurait- on aurait bien besoin de son aide, en ce moment...
The Cursed One#219.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#220.src: ... A- a- anyway! The cavern you met Syndra in is also said to be s- sa- sacred. And the feel of the crystals reminds me of h- how I feel there.
The Cursed One#220.dst: ... B- b- bref! La caverne où tu as rencontré Syndra serait aussi s- sa- sacrée. Et les cristaux me font le même effet que c- ce que je ressens là-bas.
The Cursed One#220.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#221.src: So- s- so if we can find our way into the tree... we co- could find some m- ma- s- some magical wood. Follow me!
The Cursed One#221.dst: Al- a- alors si on arrive à entrer dans l'arbre... on p- pourrait trouver du b- bo- d- du bois magique. Suis-moi!
The Cursed One#221.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#222.src: Head to the top of the giant tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#222.dst: Montez au sommet de l'arbre géant en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#223.src: Hey! F- faster than last time! Keep up the im- im- improvement, and maybe soon I'll have to put in mo- more than {~}!
The Cursed One#223.dst: Hé! P- plus rapide que la dernière fois! Continue à pro- pro- progresser, et je devrai peut-être bientôt y mettre p- plus de {~}!
The Cursed One#223.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#224.src: Ha... yeah... Um, earlier you m- me- mentioned that magic can be found in- in everything.
The Cursed One#224.dst: Ha... ouais... Euh, tout à l'heure, tu as m- men- mentionné que la magie se trouve d- dans tout.
The Cursed One#224.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#225.src: So... so ma- maybe we didn't need to come to- to- to this old tree... But- b- but it feels right to me.
The Cursed One#225.dst: Alors... alors p- peut-être qu'on n'avait pas besoin de venir à- à- à ce vieil arbre... Mais- m- mais ça me semble juste.
The Cursed One#225.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#226.src: ... Thank you for c- c- coming along.
The Cursed One#226.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#227.src: It's a breath of fresh air, having someone n- n- new around! I don't know, having you around just f- fe- feels... good! Like- like anything is possible!
The Cursed One#227.dst: Ça fait un bol d'air frais, d'avoir quelqu'un de n- n- nouveau dans le coin! Je sais pas, t'avoir ici, ça- ç- ça fait... du bien! Comme- comme si tout était possible!
The Cursed One#227.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#228.src: ... Oh, I- I- I'm getting too sappy. Sorry, sorry!
The Cursed One#228.dst: ... Oh, je- je- je deviens trop sentimental. Pardon, pardon!
The Cursed One#228.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#229.src: Well... my h- h- my heart is telling me that this wood is what I w- w- what I want!
The Cursed One#229.dst: Bon... mon c- c- mon coeur me dit que ce bois, c'est ce que je v- v- ce que je veux!
The Cursed One#229.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#230.src: That old tale... it's one of the o- o- only things I still remember from my childhood.
The Cursed One#230.dst: Ce vieux conte... c'est l'une des s- s- seules choses dont je me souviens encore de mon enfance.
The Cursed One#230.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#231.src: So, s- so this is definitely what I want my w- we- weapon to be made out of.
The Cursed One#231.dst: A- alors c'est vraiment en ça que je veux mon a- ar- arme.
The Cursed One#231.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#232.src: We might as well just have g
The Cursed One#232.dst: On aurait pu prendre n'importe quel bois.

The Cursed One#233.src: Oh... y- y- yeah. Maybe you're right...
The Cursed One#233.dst: Oh... o- o- ouais. Tu as peut-être raison...
The Cursed One#233.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#234.src: I just thought... choosing s- some- something special to me would- would be b- best.
The Cursed One#234.dst: Je pensais juste... que choisir q- quel- quelque chose de spécial pour moi serait- serait le m- mieux.
The Cursed One#234.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#235.src: B- but we're here now any- a- anyway, aren't we? So we can just use the- the- the wood here...
The Cursed One#235.dst: M- mais on est là de toute f- f- façon, non? Alors on peut juste utiliser l- l- le bois d'ici...
The Cursed One#235.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#236.src: So, we've gotta find a way into the tr- the tree...
The Cursed One#236.dst: Bon, il faut trouver un moyen d'entrer dans l'a- l'arbre...
The Cursed One#236.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#237.src: Ha, I- I'm not exactly a wood- woodcutting expert... maybe it'd have been smart to ask Mora t- to- to join us?
The Cursed One#237.dst: Ha, je- je suis pas vraiment un expert en bû- bûcheronnage... ça aurait peut-être été malin de demander à Mora de v- ve- venir?
The Cursed One#237.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#238.src: ... Do- do you have any ideas? May- maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#238.dst: ... T- tu as une idée? Peut- peut-être que tu pourrais percer avec un s- so- sort?
The Cursed One#238.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#239.src: Cast a spell ontop of the tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#239.dst: Lancez un sort au sommet de l'arbre en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#240.src: Maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#240.dst: Peut-être que tu pourrais percer avec un s- so- sort?
The Cursed One#240.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#241.dst: Ouah! Qu'est-ce qui vient de se passer?!
The Cursed One#241.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#242.src: ... Do- do you think the t- tr- the tree heard me earlier? Is it...
The Cursed One#242.dst: ... T- tu crois que l'a- ar- l'arbre m'a entendu tout à l'heure? Est-ce qu'il...
The Cursed One#242.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#243.src: This- th- this has to be a sign! Come on, let's go in!
The Cursed One#243.dst: C- c- ça doit être un signe! Allez, entrons!
The Cursed One#243.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#244.src: Find the wood Zeph wants at the end of the root system.
The Cursed One#244.dst: Trouvez le bois que Zeph veut au bout des racines.

The Cursed One#245.src: Th- th- there! That should- sh- should be a big enough chunk for Mora... right?
The Cursed One#245.dst: L- l- là! Ce morceau d- de- devrait suffire à Mora... non?
The Cursed One#245.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#246.src: A- and- you're still not fast enough to beat me to th- th- to the end!
The Cursed One#246.dst: E- et- tu n'es toujours pas assez rapide pour arriver au b- b- au bout avant moi!
The Cursed One#246.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#247.src: Okay, next... We- weapons are usually made of m- me- metal, right? That's why Mora has a f- fo- a forge.
The Cursed One#247.dst: Bon, ensuite... Les a- armes sont souvent en m- mé- métal, non? C'est pour ça que Mora a une f- fo- une forge.
The Cursed One#247.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#248.src: ...I have a- an- an idea! Let's meet up near {p}, wh- where we first met.
The Cursed One#248.dst: ...J'ai u- un- une idée! Retrouvons-nous près de {p}, l- là où on s'est rencontrés.
The Cursed One#248.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#250.src: O- okay, so. The crown usually uses t- ti- titanium for their equipment. Th- that's what Mora says, at least.
The Cursed One#250.dst: B- bon, alors. La Couronne utilise souvent du t- ti- titane pour son équipement. C- c'est ce que dit Mora, en tout cas.
The Cursed One#250.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#251.src: But- b- but, it can be hard to come by, b- be- because the crown keeps most of it for themselves.
The Cursed One#251.dst: Mais- m- mais c'est dur à trouver, p- par- parce que la Couronne en garde presque tout pour elle.
The Cursed One#251.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#252.src: Luckily, it's F- F- Festival time, so a bunch of m- merchants are in town! And they're fr- from all over the p- pr- province, not just here!
The Cursed One#252.dst: Par chance, c'est l'époque du F- F- Festival, alors plein de m- marchands sont en ville! Et ils viennent d- de toute la p- pro- province, pas seulement d'ici!
The Cursed One#252.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#253.src: So someone m- must have titanium, somewhere... we'll j- just- just have to look around.
The Cursed One#253.dst: Alors quelqu'un d- doit bien avoir du titane, quelque part... on va j- juste- juste devoir chercher.
The Cursed One#253.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#254.src: Ah! Th- that- that's the Sovereign!
The Cursed One#254.dst: Ah! C- c'est- c'est le Souverain!
The Cursed One#254.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#255.src: ...and alongside that, does she really think it's safe to hold the festival right now, sir? That opens up a really big risk!
The Cursed One#255.dst: ...et en plus, croit-elle vraiment qu'il est prudent d'organiser le festival maintenant, monsieur? Ça ouvre la porte à un risque énorme!
The Cursed One#255.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#256.src: What do you th- th- think they're t- talking about? Come on, let- l- let's shadow them.
The Cursed One#256.dst: De quoi tu c- c- crois qu'ils p- parlent? Allez, s- s- suivons-les.
The Cursed One#256.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#257.src: If the cursed thinks they can get past both myself and Her Majesty, they're out of their vector. You don't need to worry about the people.
The Cursed One#257.dst: Si le maudit croit pouvoir passer outre moi et Sa Majesté, il a perdu la raison... géométrique. Tu n'as pas à t'inquiéter pour le peuple.
The Cursed One#257.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#258.src: I was more worried about... ...um... W-well, never mind that! If you think we'll all be safe, sir, I'll take you at your word!
The Cursed One#258.dst: Je m'inquiétais plutôt pour... ...euh... B-bon, peu importe! Si vous pensez que nous serons tous en sécurité, monsieur, je vous crois sur parole!
The Cursed One#258.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#259.src: Let me rephrase- you don't need to worry about anyone. ...heh. Any- wait. What's that noise?
The Cursed One#259.dst: Je reformule- tu n'as à t'inquiéter pour personne. ...hé. Perso- attends. C'est quoi, ce bruit?
The Cursed One#259.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#260.src: Just someone out on a random walk? Back to the point- is everything for the festival shaping up according to schedule?
The Cursed One#260.dst: Quelqu'un en pleine marche aléatoire, sans doute? Revenons-en au fait- tout se met-il en place pour le festival selon le calendrier?
The Cursed One#260.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#261.src: Oh- yes! Yes it is, sir! The vendors have all been assigned, the game stands have all been constructed, we've commissioned a local band... The one you liked last year!
The Cursed One#261.dst: Oh- oui! Absolument, monsieur! Les marchands ont tous leur place, les stands de jeux sont tous montés, nous avons engagé un orchestre local... Celui que vous avez aimé l'an dernier!
The Cursed One#261.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#262.src: Golden. That rendition of "CHASE" is what really sold me on them.
The Cursed One#262.dst: Du nombre d'or. C'est leur version de "CHASE" qui m'a vraiment convaincu.
The Cursed One#262.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#263.src: That just leaves your speech, sir! Have you- Oh, who am I kidding, you already have it memorized.
The Cursed One#263.dst: Il ne reste que votre discours, monsieur! L'avez-vous- Oh, qui j'essaie de tromper, vous le connaissez déjà par coeur.
The Cursed One#263.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#264.src: Naturally, Xao. We have the whole festival set down to the last point, it looks like. Any more business to factor out?
The Cursed One#264.dst: Naturellement, Xao. On dirait que tout le festival est réglé jusqu'à la dernière décimale. D'autres affaires à mettre en facteur?
The Cursed One#264.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#265.src: Yes, sir! I've received word that Inquisitor Renn will be arriving tonight, as you sent me to request for!
The Cursed One#265.dst: Oui, monsieur! On m'a informé que l'Inquisiteur Renn arrivera ce soir, comme vous m'aviez chargé de le demander!
The Cursed One#265.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#266.src: Fantastic job. I have to remember that the Inquisitors aren't like me. When they're busy they can't just go triple-time... Still, good to have that problem solved.
The Cursed One#266.dst: Excellent travail. Je dois me rappeler que les Inquisiteurs ne sont pas comme moi. Occupés, ils ne peuvent pas passer au triple de la vitesse... Enfin, un problème de résolu.
The Cursed One#266.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#267.src: You know, they should check your work. This is proof positive they can keep pace with me like you can.
The Cursed One#267.dst: Tu sais, on devrait examiner ton travail. C'est la preuve par neuf qu'on peut suivre mon rythme, comme toi.
The Cursed One#267.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#268.src: Well! Sir! You know I've had to insist you stop and rest sometimes, and Inquisitors do serve the whole of the province, so...
The Cursed One#268.dst: Eh bien! Monsieur! Vous savez que j'ai parfois dû insister pour que vous vous reposiez, et les Inquisiteurs servent toute la province, alors...
The Cursed One#268.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#269.src: Hmm... ev- even with us r- r- raiding Nixeph, he isn't concerned...
The Cursed One#269.dst: Hmm... m- même avec notre a- a- attaque sur Nixeph, il ne s'inquiète pas...
The Cursed One#269.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#270.src: A- and- an Inquisitor! Th- that- that's not good. We need to tell the others to be c- ca- careful...
The Cursed One#270.dst: E- et- un Inquisiteur! C- ça- c'est pas bon. Il faut dire aux autres d'être p- pru- prudents...
The Cursed One#270.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#271.src: Oh! R- r- right! You're not from here. They're, uh, b- b- bad news. They're sent to d- d- deal with... um, c- cursed ones, and other s- si- similar stuff.
The Cursed One#271.dst: Oh! C- c- c'est vrai! Tu n'es pas d'ici. C'est, euh, de m- m- mauvais augure. On les envoie s'o- o- occuper des... euh, M- Maudits, et d'autres trucs s- sem- semblables.
The Cursed One#271.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#272.src: If one's a- around... we have to b- be careful. But, since w- we- since we're here, we should still find the t- ti- titanium.
The Cursed One#272.dst: S'il y en a un d- dans le coin... il faut faire a- attention. Mais, p- puis- puisqu'on est là, on devrait quand même trouver le t- ti- titane.
The Cursed One#272.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#273.src: There's a b- b- bazaar in the tunnel... if anyone wi- will have it, they'll be there.
The Cursed One#273.dst: Il y a un b- b- bazar dans le tunnel... si quelqu'un en a, c'est l- là-bas.
The Cursed One#273.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#274.dst: Trouvez le marchand de métaux en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#275.src: Fine quality metals, fine quality metals for- Ah, hello, hello! Might you be interested in my stock, friends?
The Cursed One#275.dst: Métaux de qualité, métaux de qualité pour- Ah, bonjour, bonjour! Mon stock vous intéresserait-il, mes amis?
The Cursed One#275.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#276.src: I've got all sorts for sale. Ingots, pre-made bangles and bracelets and trinkets- I've got hold of this lovely iron leaf, in fact. Quite fine decor, I might think!
The Cursed One#276.dst: J'ai de tout à vendre. Lingots, joncs et bracelets déjà faits, babioles- je me suis même procuré cette ravissante feuille de fer. Une bien belle décoration, je dirais!
The Cursed One#276.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#277.src: Hello! We're a- ac- actually looking for titanium! Would you h- ha- happen to have any in stock?
The Cursed One#277.dst: Bonjour! En f- fa- fait, on cherche du titane! Vous en au- au- auriez en stock, par hasard?
The Cursed One#277.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#278.src: Aha, you're in luck then! I've managed to obtain some from a passing {p} merchant! Straight from the {p}- and so I'm told, quite good quality!
The Cursed One#278.dst: Aha, vous avez de la chance, alors! J'en ai obtenu auprès d'un marchand de {p} de passage! Tout droit venu de {p}- et, à ce qu'on m'a dit, de très bonne qualité!
The Cursed One#278.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#279.src: I think the man was struck dumb by the offer of leaves I handed in return, he left with such a bewildered face- but I digress! Would you like ingots, or anything pre-hewn?
The Cursed One#279.dst: Je crois que l'homme est resté sans voix devant les feuilles que je lui ai offertes en échange, il est reparti si perplexe- mais je m'égare! Voulez-vous des lingots, ou quelque chose de déjà façonné?
The Cursed One#279.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#280.src: Uh... just- j- just some ingots would be fine.
The Cursed One#280.dst: Euh... juste- j- juste quelques lingots, ça ira.
The Cursed One#280.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#281.src: Indeed, then! It is always fine to see those interested in the crafting trades. For this, I might say ten Liff Leaves would be an agreeable price, yes?
The Cursed One#281.dst: Entendu, alors! C'est toujours un plaisir de voir des gens s'intéresser à l'artisanat. Pour ceci, je dirais que dix feuilles de Liff seraient un prix raisonnable, non?
The Cursed One#281.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#282.src: Ten!? Oh, f- fine... you said h- high- high quality? It's pr- probably worth the price. Here.
The Cursed One#282.dst: Dix!? Oh, b- bon... vous avez dit de h- hau- haute qualité? Ça vaut s- sûrement le prix. Tenez.
The Cursed One#282.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#283.src: Indeed, friend, so I have been assured! May you have fine fortune in your endeavors!
The Cursed One#283.dst: En effet, l'ami, c'est ce qu'on m'a assuré! Que la fortune sourie à vos entreprises!
The Cursed One#283.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#285.src: Hm... I d- don't- I don't think titanium is meant to have th- these purple streaks...
The Cursed One#285.dst: Hm... je c- crois- je crois pas que le titane soit censé avoir c- ces veines violettes...
The Cursed One#285.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#286.src: But I- I- I'm not the blacksmith, so... a- a- and it's not like anyone else is s- se- selling titanium, so.
The Cursed One#286.dst: Mais je- je- je suis pas le forgeron, alors... e- e- et c'est pas comme si quelqu'un d'autre v- ven- vendait du titane, alors.
The Cursed One#286.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#287.src: Huh? Oh, r- r- right, I keep forgetting you don't know e- ev- everything around here.
The Cursed One#287.dst: Hein? Oh, c- c- c'est vrai, j'oublie toujours que tu ne connais pas t- tou- tout par ici.
The Cursed One#287.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#288.src: The Auburn F- Fo- Forest may be a poorer area, so we d- do- don't have many emeralds...
The Cursed One#288.dst: La f- fo- forêt d'Auburn est peut-être une région pauvre, alors on n'a p- pa- pas beaucoup d'émeraudes...
The Cursed One#288.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#289.src: But we make up for it by u- u- using all the varied m- materials from the forest! People here v- val- value things from the wild more than e- em- emeralds.
The Cursed One#289.dst: Mais on compense en u- u- utilisant tous les m- matériaux de la forêt! Ici, les gens a- ac- accordent plus de valeur aux choses de la nature qu'aux é- é- émeraudes.
The Cursed One#289.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#290.src: Liff Leaves especially are in high d- d- demand due to their versatility.
The Cursed One#290.dst: Les feuilles de Liff surtout sont très d- d- demandées, car elles servent à tout.
The Cursed One#290.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#291.src: You don't need a- an- anything else? Then I'm r- ready to go.
The Cursed One#291.dst: Tu n'as besoin de r- ri- rien d'autre? Alors je suis p- prêt à partir.
The Cursed One#291.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#292.src: Want to tr- travel back with me?
The Cursed One#292.dst: Tu v- veux rentrer avec moi?
The Cursed One#292.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#295.src: Okay! I'll m- m- meet you later, then.
The Cursed One#295.dst: D'accord! On se r- r- retrouve plus tard, alors.
The Cursed One#295.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#297.src: Ah! Good, you're just in time.
The Cursed One#297.dst: Ah! Bien, vous arrivez juste à temps.
The Cursed One#297.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#298.src: Uh... in time for wh- what? A- and- and where is everybody?
The Cursed One#298.dst: Euh... à temps p- pour quoi? E- et- et où sont les autres?
The Cursed One#298.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#299.src: Have you forgotten? The Festival of the Queen is about to start!
The Cursed One#299.dst: Tu as oublié? Le Festival de la Reine va commencer!
The Cursed One#299.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#300.src: Wh- th- that was today?! Oh, man, I g- g- got so excited about the m- m- the ma- magic... I forgot!
The Cursed One#300.dst: Qu- c- c'était aujourd'hui?! Oh, la la, j'étais t- t- tellement excité par la m- m- la ma- magie... j'ai oublié!
The Cursed One#300.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#301.src: Wait... w- wait, before I go- Syndra, we o- ov- overheard something in town. The S- S- Sovereign said an In- Inquisitor would be arriving t- t- tonight!
The Cursed One#301.dst: Attends... a- attends, avant que j'y aille- Syndra, on a e- en- entendu quelque chose en ville. Le S- S- Souverain a dit qu'un In- Inquisiteur arriverait c- c- ce soir!
The Cursed One#301.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#302.src: ...ah. Well, that pushes ahead our timeline significantly...
The Cursed One#302.dst: ...ah. Eh bien, ça avance sérieusement notre calendrier...
The Cursed One#302.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#303.src: Hopefully, they're just here to clear out that cave you found the crystals in, but... better to be safe than sorry.
The Cursed One#303.dst: Avec un peu de chance, il vient juste nettoyer la grotte où vous avez trouvé les cristaux, mais... mieux vaut prévenir que guérir.
The Cursed One#303.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#304.src: That can wait until after the festival, though. You should go on ahead and enjoy yourself.
The Cursed One#304.dst: Mais ça peut attendre la fin du festival. Vas-y, va t'amuser.
The Cursed One#304.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#305.src: ...if you s- s- say so, Syndra. {u}, you should c- come to the festival too! See you there!
The Cursed One#305.dst: ...si tu le d- d- dis, Syndra. {u}, tu devrais v- venir au festival aussi! On se voit là-bas!
The Cursed One#305.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#306.src: Ah... there he goes. Well, what do you say? Will you join us for the festival?
The Cursed One#306.dst: Ah... le voilà parti. Alors, qu'en dis-tu? Tu te joins à nous pour le festival?
The Cursed One#306.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#307.src: It is a celebration of the crown... but you have a limited time here, and it is still a part of our culture. You wouldn't want to miss it.
The Cursed One#307.dst: C'est une célébration de la Couronne... mais ton temps ici est compté, et ça fait tout de même partie de notre culture. Tu ne voudrais pas manquer ça.
The Cursed One#307.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#308.src: It's a day for everyone to relax and enjoy themselves. The children certainly do... it's good for them, I think, to have some normalcy.
The Cursed One#308.dst: C'est un jour où chacun peut se détendre et s'amuser. Les enfants, en tout cas... ça leur fait du bien, je crois, un peu de normalité.
The Cursed One#308.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#309.src: I'll finish packing some things here, then I'll head on over. You should meet me there. If you head south, the river will lead you right to it.
The Cursed One#309.dst: Je finis d'emballer quelques affaires ici, puis j'arrive. Retrouve-moi là-bas. Si tu vas vers le sud, la rivière t'y mènera tout droit.
The Cursed One#309.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#310.src: Join Syndra at the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#311.src: I'll head on over soon. I just need to take care of some things before I leave.
The Cursed One#311.dst: J'arrive bientôt. J'ai juste quelques affaires à régler avant de partir.
The Cursed One#311.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#312.src: You're here! Allow me to welcome you to the annual Festival of the Crown.
The Cursed One#312.dst: Te voilà! Permets-moi de t'accueillir au Festival annuel de la Couronne.
The Cursed One#312.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#313.src: I have some business to attend to, so Zeph, would you be able to show {u} around?
The Cursed One#313.dst: J'ai des affaires à régler, alors Zeph, tu pourrais faire visiter les lieux à {u}?
The Cursed One#313.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#315.src: So there's some g- games over there... and right here is the f- foo- food and beverages s- s- stand!
The Cursed One#315.dst: Alors il y a des j- jeux là-bas... et juste ici, c'est le stand de n- nou- nourriture et de b- b- boissons!
The Cursed One#315.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#316.src: They sell re- r- regional food and drinks. And, a- ac- according to Rex... they've even im- im- imported some fancy alcohol from the h- high- highlands!
The Cursed One#316.dst: Ils vendent des plats et des boissons de la r- r- région. Et, d- da- d'après Rex... ils ont même im- im- importé de l'alcool chic des H- Hau- Hautes-Terres!
The Cursed One#316.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#317.src: Here are some at- attractions, and an animal exhibit! I, uh, d- d- don't- I don't like the Mudkins game very much...
The Cursed One#317.dst: Ici, il y a des at- attractions, et une exposition d'animaux! Moi, euh, j- j- j'aime p- j'aime pas trop le jeu des Mudkins...
The Cursed One#317.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#318.src: I th- think I saw Sui back there, so... I'm gonna go h- ha- hang out with her. You sh- should check out some of the stalls!
The Cursed One#318.dst: Je c- crois que j'ai vu Sui là-bas, alors... je vais aller p- pa- passer un moment avec elle. Tu d- devrais aller voir les stands!
The Cursed One#318.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#320.src: ...thank you, Jiro. It's always good to hear from-
The Cursed One#320.dst: ...merci, Jiro. C'est toujours bon d'avoir des nouvelles de-
The Cursed One#320.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#322.src: Hm? Oh, that's just {u}- they're who I was hoping to write to Quill about. {u}, this is Jiro, my contact from the Roughworks.
The Cursed One#322.dst: Hm? Oh, c'est juste {u}- c'est justement à son sujet que je voulais écrire à Quill. {u}, voici Jiro, mon contact à Roughworks.
The Cursed One#322.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#323.src: Ah. Well, it's good to meet you then.
The Cursed One#323.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#324.src: Quill is... an old friend. It can be hard for us to stay in contact... discretely... so we often send messages this way.
The Cursed One#324.dst: Quill est... un vieil ami. Difficile pour nous de rester en contact... discrètement... alors on passe souvent par là pour nos messages.
The Cursed One#324.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#325.src: Wasn't going to use my yearly rail pass for anything anyway, so might as well.
The Cursed One#325.dst: J'allais pas utiliser mon pass ferroviaire annuel pour autre chose, de toute façon, alors autant.
The Cursed One#325.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#326.src: Well, it's more than I'm able to do, so I appreciate it. In any case, Quill runs his own... organization, shall we say.
The Cursed One#326.dst: Eh bien, c'est plus que je ne peux en faire, alors je te remercie. En tout cas, Quill dirige sa propre... organisation, disons.
The Cursed One#326.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#328.src: The Roughworks is the region directly to the south of here, just past the wall. Officially, it's known as the {p}.
The Cursed One#328.dst: Roughworks, c'est la région juste au sud d'ici, passé le mur. Officiellement, on l'appelle {p}.
The Cursed One#328.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#329.src: I can fill you in on it later. This isn't the place for it.
The Cursed One#329.dst: Je t'expliquerai plus tard. Ce n'est pas l'endroit.
The Cursed One#329.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#330.src: ...ahem. Should we get back to it then?
The Cursed One#330.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#331.src: We should. {u}, take a look around the stalls and come back later.
The Cursed One#331.dst: Oui. {u}, fais un tour des stands et reviens plus tard.
The Cursed One#331.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#332.src: {u}, take a look around the stalls and come back later.
The Cursed One#332.dst: {u}, fais un tour des stands et reviens plus tard.
The Cursed One#332.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#334.src: You're here visiting too I see!
The Cursed One#334.dst: Je vois que toi aussi, tu es là en visite!
The Cursed One#334.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#335.src: I plan on touring the whole festival this year around. Next up for me is the {p}!
The Cursed One#335.dst: Cette année, je compte faire toute la tournée du festival. Ma prochaine étape: {p}!
The Cursed One#335.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#336.src: But the Auburn festival is known for the best food and beverages around the province. Trust me! Those rumours are true.
The Cursed One#336.dst: Mais le festival d'Auburn est réputé pour avoir les meilleurs plats et boissons de la province. Crois-moi! Les rumeurs sont vraies.
The Cursed One#336.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#337.src: Will that be enough boar meat, ma'am?
The Cursed One#337.dst: Ça suffira, comme viande de sanglier, madame?
The Cursed One#337.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#338.src: Yes, dear. Thank you for always being so kind-hearted, helping us out each and every year.
The Cursed One#338.dst: Oui, ma chérie. Merci d'être toujours si gentille et de nous aider chaque année.
The Cursed One#338.speaker: Food Merchant

The Cursed One#339.src: No worries, Oya! Hope you sell-... oh. It's you.
The Cursed One#339.dst: De rien, Oya! J'espère que vous vendrez-... oh. C'est toi.
The Cursed One#339.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#342.src: Huh? I'm just here with a delivery. Nothing much.
The Cursed One#342.dst: Hein? Je fais juste une livraison. Rien de spécial.
The Cursed One#342.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#344.src: Just cause you've got everyone else wrapped around your finger, doesn't mean I have to be fine with you!
The Cursed One#344.dst: C'est pas parce que tu mènes tous les autres par le bout du nez que je dois t'accepter!
The Cursed One#344.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#345.src: Everything was fine until you showed up. I- I- I'd gotten over it! I made a home here, and now- and now, you-
The Cursed One#345.dst: Tout allait bien avant que tu débarques. Je- je- j'avais tourné la page! Je m'étais fait une place ici, et maintenant- et maintenant, toi-
The Cursed One#345.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#346.src: And- and sure, I'm happy for Zeph, but your- your- your everything, it's got Syndra plotting, and- and we were safe, and you've ruined that.
The Cursed One#346.dst: Et- et d'accord, je suis contente pour Zeph, mais ton- ton- tout ton truc, ça pousse Syndra à comploter, et- et on était en sécurité, et tu as tout gâché.
The Cursed One#346.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#347.src: So... so, no, I don't have to be okay with you. I don't trust you, I don't trust where you're from, and I definitely don't trust your... your c-
The Cursed One#347.dst: Alors... alors non, j'ai pas à t'accepter. J'ai pas confiance en toi, ni en ton pays, et j'ai encore moins confiance en ta... ta mal-
The Cursed One#347.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#350.src: Have you seen an- any- anyone else yet?
The Cursed One#350.dst: Tu as vu q- quel- quelqu'un d'autre?
The Cursed One#350.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#351.src: I was, um, looking for Mora... earlier. I, ah, didn't find him.
The Cursed One#351.dst: Je cherchais, euh, Mora... tout à l'heure. Je, ah, je l'ai pas trouvé.
The Cursed One#351.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#352.src: We, uh, s- saw Rex run past just a bit ago. Did s- so- something happen?
The Cursed One#352.dst: On a, euh, v- vu Rex passer en courant tout à l'heure. Il s'est p- pa- passé quelque chose?
The Cursed One#352.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#353.src: I can... um, take a guess.
The Cursed One#353.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#354.src: An- anyway, how are you liking the f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#354.dst: B- bref, il te plaît, le f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#354.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#355.src: Hey, th- that's good to hear!
The Cursed One#355.dst: Hé, c- ça fait plaisir à entendre!
The Cursed One#355.speaker: Zeph
